caveats: Day-of-year is a fixed 366-day calendar by month/day (1 March = 61 in every year; non-leap years have no day 60). Each non-60 day-of-year pool holds exactly 121 dates: the +-5 calendar-day window around each of the 11 baseline years' dates of that month/day, including 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05. The smoothing wrap uses day 366 = 31 Dec of the same fixed calendar (days 1-15 adjacent); it does not affect the June-August target comparisons. Sea cells (3294 of 3600) have finite SST on every target day; other cells are masked 0. SST stored as float32 was promoted to float64 for all computations.
